title: Needs to be improved
body: It would be a very useful app... if it synchronized well with my Apple watch. But that’s not the case, I only see 3 habits at once, and it should removed from the view if I complete one.
author: Fjkdiritkf

title: Just what I needed
body: This tool has clearly increased my efficiency in picking up new habits.I used just to have a list, but the flexibility it offers makes it much more manageable to have the right information at the right time.
author: Ciprian80
